name: Lewis County, MO
findings: Lewis County has 51 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 16 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (46% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Lewis County has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
28% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Lewis County list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.0 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 16 organizations here; 49% of all organizations here have no identified type.
